# caputchin_team (Data Source)

Look up an existing Caputchin team by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "caputchin_team" "existing" {
  id = "team_abc123"
}

output "team_name" {
  value = data.caputchin_team.existing.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Team identifier.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Owning account identifier.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
- `kind` (String) Team kind (`personal` or `shared`).
- `name` (String) Team name.
- `tier` (String) Plan tier inherited from the owning account.
